oracle_nav.direction: signed (oracle − independent)/independent; positive ⇒ oracle over-values collateral (dangerous, alerted); negative ⇒ oracle conservative (safe, not alerted)
oracle_nav.method: independent NAV = min(coin spot price) × pool get_virtual_price(); divergence vs collatOracle latestAnswer (optimistic). Alert fires only when oracle over-values by > threshold_pct.

supply_composition.basis: share of real_supply by minting source (cdp + pol)
supply_composition.susg_note: sUSG holds circulating USG; it is a SUBSET of supply, not a third minting source, so it is excluded from the denominator above and reported as a share of supply instead.

asset_specific.paused_settings_semantics: getPausedSettings() -> (isDepositPaused, isBorrowPaused, isLeveragePaused). PauseEnum has exactly three members and NO liquidation pause exists anywhere in the contract, so an all-set tuple cannot strand debt: it keeps accruing and stays liquidatable on the ordinary path. setPause is gated on controlTower.isPauser(), a role distinct from the 3-of-5 Safe. Decoded 2026-08-16 from Tangent Finance verified source (StakeDaoVaultV2Market / MarketExternalActions).

backing.basis: Anchored on a measured debt-weighted CR floor of 113.15% (implied by a debt-weighted liquidation threshold), at floor +45/+32/+17/+7pp. The generic [130,110,100,90] rates this book 5/5.
backing.idle_markets_note: Zero-debt markets. Each is a latent shift in the debt-weighted floor: activating one re-weights the mean and can invalidate these cutoffs before review_by.
backing.expiry_reason: The floor is a debt-weighted mean over an ACTIVE MARKET SET the issuer opens and pauses — a property of today's book, not of the protocol. Re-derive it, do not extend the date.

peg.market_price_as_of_basis: Analyzer run clock. The Curve PegKeeper pools are read on-chain within this run and the mark is a pure function of that read, so this bounds the mark's age by the run duration. NOT an independent per-quote observation stamp — no venue timestamp is available.
peg.market_price_self_referential_basis: Quoted from the same Curve PegKeeper pools measured by the liquidity axis. No external or routed cross-check is wired for USG today; a CoinGecko or aggregator-routed mark would dissolve this rather than relocate it. Until then the premium/discount is venue-internal and cannot evidence venue-wide mispricing.

liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: Even split across every regulator-enumerated USG PegKeeper Curve pool; each pool is quoted independently with get_dy(USG index, counter index, equal share of size). The published lower rung is known to clear inside 2%; the upper rung crosses 2%. ⚠️ Even split is executable but is not claimed to be solver-optimal. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL (average realized cost over the whole fill), measured versus $1 NOMINAL USG rather than the venue spot rate — not marginal impact. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal, and the $1 denominator differs from the venue-spot denominator this estate's shared builders use, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.
liquidity.sell_side_basis: Counter-side (USDC/frxUSD) inventory across the PegKeeper Curve pools — what a USG seller can actually execute into. The USG side of the same pools is not exit liquidity for a seller.

exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: ALL-IN COST against notional: (output_usd - size) / size. Includes the venue's base spread, so it is not comparable rung-for-rung with a price-impact figure measured against a venue's own spot rung.

excluded_from_rating.reason: peg-defense capability, not observed market depth
pool composition — surfaced above and on the peg axis, but rating it here would conflate skew with depth

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Debt-weighted mean across active CDP markets. For a CDP book the aggregate CR IS the market mark, so it is pulled by any market with unusual collateralisation regardless of that market's size.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: Implied by the rated ratio: total_backing - total_backing/(collateral_ratio/100) — collateral in excess of the debt it secures, on the debt-weighted basis the ratio uses. ⚠️ NOT collateral + POL stables - supply, which answers a different question and is published as surplus_deficit_vs_supply.

concentration.note: The aggregate clears 130% only because of the markets listed above. Strip them and the rest of the book sits close to its own liquidation floor — which is what the backing cutoffs are anchored on.
